note: Options of the awks that are NOT installed on the machine that recorded the fixtures (gawk, mawk). They come from the awks' manual pages, not from a probe: the reader never relies on them (text-programs.ts judges every word that is not the value of -F, -v or -f, which every awk reads the same way), and the live test fails on a machine whose awk is not the recorded one so the table is re-verified there.
